title: dspy
summary: DSPy is a framework for building and optimizing LLM-powered applications. It allows developers to programmatically define complex LLM workflows using composable modules and declarative signatures, moving beyond simple prompt engineering. The framework then automatically optimizes these programs using advanced techniques like few-shot learning and prompt refinement, significantly improving their robustness and performance. Users can integrate with various LLMs, manage data, and evaluate their applications with built-in metrics.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Human User
nodes.description: The developer or user who designs, builds, optimizes, and deploys DSPy programs for various LLM-powered applications.

nodes.label: Define & Build LLM Programs
nodes.title: Core DSPy Framework
nodes.description: Provides the foundational building blocks for DSPy programs, including base modules, signature definitions for LM tasks, flexible data types, and tool execution capabilities. This is where users compose their LLM pipelines.

nodes.label: Integrate & Manage LLMs
nodes.title: Language Model Integration
nodes.description: Handles all aspects of interacting with various Large Language Models. This includes client interfaces, caching for efficiency, streaming capabilities for real-time output, and provider-specific integrations for advanced features like finetuning.

nodes.label: Optimize & Evaluate Programs
nodes.title: Program Optimization & Evaluation
nodes.description: Offers a comprehensive suite of tools for automatically improving and assessing DSPy programs. This includes teleprompters for automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and various metrics for robust performance evaluation.

nodes.label: Implement Prediction & Retrieval
nodes.title: Prediction & Retrieval Strategies
nodes.description: Provides core strategies for generating predictions and retrieving relevant information. This encompasses advanced prediction techniques, agentic behaviors (e.g., ReAct), and various retrieval mechanisms to augment LLM capabilities.

nodes.label: Manage Data & General Utilities
nodes.title: Data & General Utilities
nodes.description: Contains tools for loading, processing, and managing datasets, along with general-purpose utilities for file handling, asynchronous execution, and callback management. It also includes tools for documentation generation.

groups.label: Program Development
groups.title: DSPy Program Development
groups.description: The core process of designing, building, and structuring LLM-powered applications using DSPy's programmatic primitives and composition model.

groups.label: LLM Interaction & Strategies
groups.title: LLM Interaction & Strategies
groups.description: Manages how DSPy programs interact with Large Language Models, including client integrations, caching, streaming, and advanced prediction and retrieval patterns.

groups.label: Optimization & Evaluation
groups.title: Program Optimization & Evaluation
groups.description: Focuses on automatically improving the performance of DSPy programs through techniques like prompt engineering and few-shot learning, along with robust evaluation metrics.

groups.label: Supporting Infrastructure
groups.title: Data, Utilities & Docs
groups.description: Provides essential datasets, general-purpose utilities for file handling and async operations, and tools for generating comprehensive documentation for DSPy projects.
